record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace each scoring-position representation h_t with 0.8*h_t + 0.2*mean(h_j), averaging over the last four nonpadding encoder states ending at t, or all available states if fewer. Apply this causal pooling to every training target and use the final real position at inference. A small recent-context contribution may stabilize sparse histories while preserving the latest state's dominance. Keep history length, positions, embeddings, causal backbone, dot-product scorer, loss and optimizer fixed; synchronize the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, blend each normalized encoder state with the causal mean of up to four recent nonpadding states: 0.8 current + 0.2 recent mean. This may stabilize short histories while retaining the latest state's dominance. Preserve the causal backbone, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. The predictor imports the updated model class; a metadata check keeps its readout consistent with training.
